security.evidence: lib/pilot-access.ts:3-66 and app/api/pilot-access/route.ts:15-39: one shared code creates an unsigned-user HMAC session for 12 hours; no logout or individual subject exists.
security.scenario: A code or unlocked shared workstation gives indistinguishable access; one advisor cannot be revoked or attributed separately.
security.impact: Reduced accountability and offboarding; residual unauthorized-access risk.
security.remediation_direction: Before real data, adopt named identities or document a tightly controlled four-advisor model with dedicated devices, code distribution, whole-pilot revocation and browser-close procedure; add logout.
security.validation_needed: Retest login, individual revocation, logout, session expiry, shared-workstation clearing and API authorization.

security.evidence: No application rate limiter is present. docs/pilot-security.md explicitly requires host/edge rate limiting; Railway configuration evidence was not available. Analysis admission only limits one active analysis per process.
security.scenario: Repeated code guesses or authenticated cost abuse are not throttled by application code; multi-replica limits would not be shared.
security.impact: Credential guessing, service exhaustion or AI cost exposure.
security.remediation_direction: Verify and document Railway/edge rate limits for login and analysis plus OpenAI budget alerts before real data.
security.validation_needed: Read-only configuration evidence and low-volume functional verification of limit headers/status.

security.evidence: Safe production HEAD/GET on 2026-09-29 showed no Content-Security-Policy, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or HSTS; next.config.ts only configures no-store for /api/analyze.
security.scenario: Authenticated pages can be framed and browser hardening relies on defaults; outbound source-link referrers are not explicitly minimized.
security.impact: Increased clickjacking/content-injection blast radius and metadata leakage.
security.remediation_direction: Add and production-verify CSP/frame protection, nosniff, strict referrer policy and appropriate HSTS/permissions policy.
security.validation_needed: Repeat safe production header inspection and framing/referrer tests.

security.evidence: Application uses memory-only request processing and store:false, but docs/pilot-security.md:42-49 states host log/temp retention, OpenAI data sharing/abuse retention/ZDR/MAM, region and DPA must be verified.
security.scenario: Customer text or metadata may remain in vendor safety/access logs longer or in a region not approved for the pilot.
security.impact: Unknown deletion/retention and data-subject response obligations.
security.remediation_direction: Record vendor configuration, retention, regions, subprocessors and deletion/escalation paths before real data.
security.validation_needed: Manual vendor-console/contract review without exposing secrets.

security.evidence: Repo contains technical security notes but no dedicated privacy notice, approved retention/deletion policy, processing record, incident procedure, DPA evidence or DPIA screening approval.
security.scenario: Advisors process real documents without a documented controller/processor model, notice, incident route or deletion responsibility.
security.impact: Uncontrolled organizational handling even if request processing is technically ephemeral.
security.remediation_direction: Complete the pre-pilot document pack and legal/organizational approvals listed in legal-organizational-review.md.
security.validation_needed: Named owner sign-off and document review before first real customer.

security.evidence: lib/document-redaction.ts applies deterministic regex redaction, then lib/analysis-batching.ts sends the full bounded extracted text for each accepted document to OpenAI. Tests cover common identifiers, not arbitrary names, prose or special-category content.
security.scenario: Unlabelled personal or sensitive prose not matched by the redactor is transmitted to the AI provider.
security.impact: More personal data may reach a processor than the UI wording "relevant, maskert tekst" may suggest.
security.remediation_direction: Use strict pilot input scope, accurate notice, vendor controls and a redaction/minimization review; exclude person-insurance documents.
security.validation_needed: Synthetic redaction corpus, outbound-marker test and legal/vendor review.

security.evidence: app/api/analysis-trace/route.ts and production trace modules remain deployed; Railway PILOT_TRACE_ENABLED was read-only verified false and the endpoint returns 404 while off.
security.scenario: A future configuration change can activate extensive structural diagnostics.
security.impact: Low while off; operational drift can expand logging.
security.remediation_direction: Remove temporary instrumentation when diagnostics are finished or add explicit change-control/expiry ownership.
security.validation_needed: Verify route remains 404/off or code is removed after controlled validation.

security.scenario: Framework identity marginally improves attacker reconnaissance.
security.remediation_direction: Disable powered-by header when security headers are added.

security.evidence: npm audit --omit=dev on 2026-09-29 reported 0 vulnerabilities across 476 total packages, but no documented recurring advisory/update process exists.
security.scenario: New advisories may remain unnoticed after this audit.
security.impact: Security posture can decay over time.
security.remediation_direction: Assign a lightweight recurring dependency/advisory review and record the audit date.
security.validation_needed: Evidence of scheduled review and triage ownership.

product.evidence: No logout control exists; session lasts 12 hours and is shared-identity. React customer state remains until inputs change, reload or tab close.
product.advisor_impact: Shared workstations can retain access and the prior result; advisors lack an explicit end-of-case action.
product.reproduction: Login locally, complete/inspect state, observe no logout or dedicated Clear all/End customer case control.
product.remediation_direction: Add explicit logout and one-step clear/new-customer action; document browser-close procedure until delivered.

product.evidence: Upload UI gives concise AI/data text, but login/main pages have no privacy notice link, controller/contact, retention link or incident contact.
product.advisor_impact: Advisor cannot answer a customer or internal question about ownership, rights, retention or escalation from the product.
product.reproduction: Open /pilot-access and authenticated empty state; inspect visible links/text.
product.remediation_direction: Provide reviewed pilot privacy information and named support/privacy route.

product.evidence: No advisor quick-start, known-limitations handout, incident-versus-feedback guide or pilot stop process was found.
product.advisor_impact: A capable advisor can understand the core UI, but safe independent handling of errors/incidents depends on developer knowledge.
product.reproduction: Review docs inventory and UI navigation.
product.remediation_direction: Create a 10–20 minute quick guide and operating guide with stop conditions and support owner.

product.evidence: No feedback widget, submission endpoint or feedback storage exists in app/lib; no documented external feedback process exists.
product.advisor_impact: Advisors cannot consistently distinguish ordinary feedback, correctness bugs and privacy/security incidents.
product.reproduction: Search routes/components for feedback and walk local UI.
product.remediation_direction: Define a privacy-minimizing external or in-product feedback path and separate incident escalation.

product.evidence: Chrome/local semantic smoke and responsive automated checks exist; this audit did not perform a real Safari end-to-end smoke.
product.advisor_impact: Safari-specific upload, details/summary or streaming issues could surprise an advisor.
product.remediation_direction: Complete the checklist Safari smoke with synthetic data before assigning Safari users.

product.evidence: UI repeatedly displays "Ikke dokumentert" but no global in-product explanation says this is not the same as "ikke dekket"; source-origin labels are otherwise strong.
product.advisor_impact: Advisor may overinterpret uncertainty as absence of cover.
product.reproduction: Inspect empty/result copy and exact phrase search in app components.
product.remediation_direction: Add concise result-level explanation and include it in advisor guide without changing comparison semantics.

product.evidence: Changing files/modes clears results and aborts work, but there is no single explicit reset of files, manual objects, result, source panels and errors.
product.advisor_impact: End-of-case hygiene is less obvious and previous-customer state can remain visible.
product.reproduction: Use agreement workspace; observe input mutations clear result but no Clear all control.
product.remediation_direction: Add an explicit new-customer/reset action and verify tab/back/refresh behavior.

product.evidence: Production /robots.txt returns the generic English Next.js 404 page; it leaks no customer data.
product.advisor_impact: Unbranded English fallback is less professional but does not block workflow.
product.remediation_direction: Add branded localized not-found handling if useful.

product.evidence: Login is clear and keyboard-native, but it does not display session duration, logout expectation or support contact.
product.advisor_impact: Minor uncertainty about access lifecycle and help route.
product.remediation_direction: Add concise operational copy after authentication model is decided.

gdpr_readiness.technical: Memory-only application processing is well bounded and tested; external/service retention is not fully known.
gdpr_readiness.legal_basis: LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED for PDF/manual processing, AI transfer, operational logs and any feedback process.
gdpr_readiness.rights: Ephemeral app data limits local retrieval; logs/vendor data and deletion path require documentation.

dpia_screening.reason: New AI-assisted processing of financial/insurance documents, possible sensitive incidental content and potential customer impact; small controlled skadeforsikring pilot reduces scale but does not remove screening need. Legal/privacy owner must decide.
